topic.angle: CDC sleep guidance for adults and teens

card.title: How much sleep do adults need?

body.question: The CDC recommends how many hours of sleep a day for most adults aged 18 to 60?
body.reveal: Adults aged 18 to 60 are advised to get 7 or more hours. The amount you need changes as you age: teens aged 13 to 17 are advised 8 to 10 hours.

probes.question: True or false: the CDC advises teens aged 13 to 17 to get 8 to 10 hours of sleep a day.
True or false: the hours of sleep recommended each day stay the same as you age.
